title: Assign outage priority
system: You assign helpdesk priority. Output only the requested answer.
prompt:
Assign a priority of P1, P2, P3 or P4 using this scale:
P1 = entire company blocked or safety issue
P2 = a whole team blocked
P3 = one person blocked with a workaround
P4 = cosmetic or request
Reply with only the priority code (for example P1).

Ticket from John Sample, Acme Widgets Ltd:
"The office Wi-Fi and the wired LAN are both down. All 80 staff on site cannot reach email, files or the VPN. This started 10 minutes ago."
